WildSpark 2.2.53 restores WildInfo spawn timers.

- Load the omitted `WildDrops/Respawn.lua` observer so WildInfo can show local and shared respawn estimates in creature tooltips.
- Require the respawn observer in the TOC and release ZIP checks to prevent it being omitted again.

The package workflow validates that the observer is included and loaded. Live in-game timer display was not available for verification.
